Which claim in this evidence table is scientifically testable as written?

OptionClaimPossible evidence
AIncreasing ramp height reduces travel time over 2.0 m.Measure ramp height and travel time.
BThe cart moves better when it is happy.No measurable condition is defined.
CNature prefers blue carts.“Prefers” is not operationally defined.

  1. Claim A
  2. Claim B
  3. Claim C
  4. Claim D
